prompt: Create a Grade 3 Sharing the Planet standalone game about the water cycle and human impact. Include inquiry-based mechanics, TTS voice switching, and Neobrutalism styling.
expected_outputs: Traces to Grade 3 Sharing the Planet theme and lines of inquiry/key concepts (Change, Causation, Responsibility)
Standalone HTML file in src/uoi/ with viewport tag, PYP Map link, and Neobrutalism CSS tokens
Interactive inquiry manipulative rather than a plain text quiz
Includes TTS dropdown with UK/US accent selection and TTS_MANAGER implementation sharing localStorage
Sound effects using Web Audio API

prompt: Build a Grade 2 How We Express Ourselves storytelling activity called g2_script_director.html with speech synthesis read-aloud and radio-style accent switcher.
expected_outputs: File located in src/uoi/g2_script_director.html or src/literacy/

Compact iPad-friendly header without large subtitles or sticky banners eating vertical space
Read aloud button (.btn-speaker) with pulsing active state
Audio unlock on first user gesture and synthesized Web Audio sound effects
Pure English content with correct punctuation and shuffled choices

expected_outputs: Addresses transdisciplinary theme How We Organize Ourselves with clear driving question and learner agency
